the_single_question_answered: for this exact service/target/scope and this positively bounded candidate class, which candidate source universes are APPLICABLE?

applicable_source_with_missing_internal_.kind: per-source APPLICABLE then a downstream evidence state
applicable_source_with_missing_internal_.says: this APPLICABLE source's internal evidence is later insufficient

evidence_distinction.structural_enforcement: the decision object has an exact REQUIRED_FIELDS set with no internal-evidence-sufficiency field, plus an explicit FORBIDDEN_FIELDS enumeration
evidence_distinction.resolver_never_inspects_evidence: AST court asserts the production module contains zero reads of any FORBIDDEN_FIELDS attribute

this_authority_cannot.power: rank or select among applicable sources
this_authority_cannot.enforced_by: DECISION_MATRIX.may_rank_or_select is False for every state; no ordering field exists; canonical order is labelled REPLAY_ONLY
may_pool_respondents False everywhere; FORBIDDEN_AUTHORIZED_PURPOSES includes POOLING; forbidden request-key names include pooling/pool
FORBIDDEN_AUTHORIZED_PURPOSES includes RESPONDENT_LINKAGE; the key carries no respondent-level identifier
FORBIDDEN_AUTHORIZED_PURPOSES includes ESTIMAND_COMPOSITION; admitted entries remain separate and no aggregate is produced
may_authorise_backfill False everywhere; backfill is a forbidden request-key name
FORBIDDEN_AUTHORIZED_PURPOSES includes CURRENTNESS_AUTHORITY; currentness is a forbidden request-key name; there is no currentness field

this_authority_cannot.power: grant target-use permission merely because a permission ref is bound
this_authority_cannot.enforced_by: may_grant_target_use_permission is False for EVERY state including ADMITTED; the receipt records target_use_permission_refs_are_bound_input_not_a_grant

this_authority_cannot.power: infer source priority from locality or country
this_authority_cannot.enforced_by: geography_scope_ref and population_scope_ref are inclusion filters only; receipt records geography_and_population_are_inclusion_filters_only and locality_assigns_no_priority
may_condition_F8 and may_transform_geometry_or_distribution are False everywhere; eligibility is not conditioning
may_support_individual_inference False everywhere; the key carries no respondent-level identifier; FORBIDDEN_AUTHORIZED_PURPOSES includes INDIVIDUAL_INFERENCE and ACTOR_OR_PERSON_STATE

coverage_honesty.downstream_operations_requiring_exhausti: fail closed with APPLICABILITY_COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE until coverage is COMPLETE

state_isolation_proof.silence_is_never_a_verdict: a candidate with no applicability authority receives MISSING_AUTHORITY, never NOT_APPLICABLE
state_isolation_proof.ambiguity_is_never_a_negative: unknown or conflicting authority folds to UNRESOLVED
